summary: First end-to-end pass of Book Template MVP. All 8 backend pytest cases passed (Books CRUD + image upload + serve). Frontend Playwright flow validated end-to-end: Dashboard load, New Book dialog, create+navigate to editor, all toolbar testids, add text block, BlockProperties panel selection, add page (sidebar pages-list now has 2 thumbnails), page size change to Square, Save persists to backend (verified via API), Export PDF click does not throw.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (a11y - low severity, add DialogDescription)

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Dashboard create-book DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_book: when 'pages' provided, code re-validates each page via Page(**p). The list comprehension `[Page(**p).model_dump() if not isinstance(p, dict) or 'id' not in p else Page(**p).model_dump() for p in update_data['pages']]` is redundant (both branches do the same thing) - simplify to a single map.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event lifecycle hooks; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
Editor.jsx is ~610 lines and mixes Editor, PageCanvas, PageThumbnail in one file; consider splitting for maintainability per >700-line guidance (still under threshold but trending).
Editor.jsx uses document.execCommand for text formatting (deprecated by browsers); flag for future migration to Selection/Range or a library like Tiptap.
Dashboard.jsx empty-state has 'empty-create-button' but no DialogTrigger wiring — it relies on setCreateOpen(true) which is fine, but ensure focus management is tested.
No request size or content-type guard before reading file in /api/upload (file.read() happens before 10MB check). Consider streaming or relying on FastAPI's max size middleware.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Book_* test fixtures via pytest. Cleaned up Playwright-created 'Playwright Test Book' and 'Test' books after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_books_api.py and cover full CRUD + upload + 404. Reusable for regression. PDF export is client-side via html2canvas+jsPDF; only existence/click-no-throw is verified, do not validate PDF bytes in headless. Drag-drop pixel positions for react-rnd not tested (per instructions). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://manuscript-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com.
